# The clean tree holds near misses that must not be reported: lint-like text in comments, string,
# raw string and char literals, expect()/allow() method calls, cfg(doc), warn/deny attributes,
# workspace lint levels warn/deny/forbid, empty ignore lists, allowed workflow and script forms
# (--config of other tools, reads of the cargo configuration home, variables that merely contain a
# compiler name), and suppressions inside the root target/ and the fetched upstream checkout
# .upstream/, which are not scanned.
